newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Randstad in gross/net pay talks with union.
newsitem.headline: Randstad in gross/net pay talks with union.

text.p: Temporary employment agency Randstad NV said on Tuesday it was holding talks with a Dutch trade union about the way in which it pays temporary workers.
"I can confirm we are in contact with the union about the issue of gross and net payment, but I can't comment on the details," a Randstad spokesman told Reuters.

Randstad shares fell 6.50 guilders to 125.50 on a generally firmer Amsterdam bourse on Tuesday after Het Financieele Dagblad newspaper said the FNV Services Union was pressing Randstad to pay workers a gross fee, rather than a net fee. It said such a move could reduce Randstad's margins by 1.5 to 2.0 percent.
The newspaper said the union was threatening to take Randstad to court if the matter could not be settled amicably by December 9.
Shares of another Dutch temporary employment agency, Content Beheer, also slid a guilder to 67.50 on Tuesday after the Financieele Dagblad report.

The newspaper said that by paying a net fee to workers, most temporary employment agencies in the Netherlands were holding on to money that workers could otherwise claim back from the tax and social security authorities.
